claims.sourceText: MITRE's own SAGE history site, sage.mitre.org timeline
claims.text: The MITRE Corporation was incorporated as a nonprofit organization on 21 July 1958, and Robert Everett joined as its first technical director along with 485 other Lincoln Laboratory employees.

edges.label: First technical director; carried SAGE engineering authority across from MIT
edges.note: Everett joined MITRE at incorporation as first technical director and later became its president.

edges.label: MITRE was spun out of Lincoln Laboratory Division 6 in 1958
edges.note: 485 Lincoln Laboratory employees moved to the new corporation on incorporation, 21 July 1958, to continue SAGE systems engineering under Air Force sponsorship.
